scope: Chromium, white theme, 640/1280px, one-level tab traversal; screenshot body comparison excludes 42px top and bottom.
snapshotProvenanceLimit: Artifacts preserve render measurements/screenshots and side revisions, but not the restored snapshot contents or plugin lock; cache provenance is evidenced by job logs and cache keys.

knownHarnessArtifacts.diagnosis: The selected owned Sweep entry closes the gallery on Enter. The audit detects changed pane text, record() returns false for the now-missing pane scope, and the caller still declares LAY--detail. Both sides have the same declaration without a detail measurement or image. LAY--root is measured at both widths. The current artifact text confirms the owned Sweep state, and relevant base/tested/submitted source blobs match. No original evidence was changed.

paneIdentityScope.diagnosis: discover() first seeks the requested pane, but falls back to instances[0] if none matches (web-app.ts:234). ui-audit.ts:389 stores the requested token/paneId beside that returned instance, and uses the actual instance to render. A saved mismatch is a capture of another pane, not coverage of the declared pane. Symmetric mismatches with unchanged harness source predate these source changes; the exact command-resolution reason is not recovered from these artifacts.
